Name: TECHNO-CLS Project
Description: TECHNO-CLS project aims at the breakthrough in technologies needed for designing and practical realisation of novel gamma-ray Light Sources (LS) operating at photon energies from keV up to GeV range that can be constructed through exposure of oriented crystals (linear, bent and periodically bent) to the beams of ultra-relativistic charged particles. The TECHNO-CLS high-risk/high-gain science-towards-technology breakthrough research programme will address the physics of the processes accompanying the oriented crystal exposure to irradiation by the high-energy electron and positron beams at the atomistic level of detail needed for the realisation of the TECHNO-CLS goals. A broad interdisciplinary, international collaboration has been created previously in the frame of FP7 and H2020 projects, which performed initial experimental tests to demonstrate the crystalline undulator (CU) idea, production and characterisation of periodically bent crystals and the related theory. Additionally, by means of a pre-bunched beam a CU LS has a potential to generate coherent superradiant radiation with wavelengths orders of magnitudes less than 1 Angstrom, i.e. within the range that cannot be reached in existing LSs based on magnetic undulators. Such LSs will have many applications in the basic sciences including nuclear and solid-state physics and the life sciences. Theoretical, computational, experimental and technological results obtained in the course of this project will pave a way for key technological developments of the LSs and their wide exploitation. The TECHNO-CLS international collaboration possesses all the necessary expertise to successfully conduct the outlined programme.

Description:
HISTORY

CARD TECHNOLOGIES  was originally founded in 2004 by DR. SERIGNE DIOUM, who remains its Chief Science Officer and acts as its Chief Executive Officer. The company specializes in Nanotechnology Research and Development in environmental and biological areas. At present, Card Technologies' facilities are located in Olivet, France (just south of Orleans). In 2013, Mr. Ralph Ledee, a US investor, provided angel capital to convert the R&D-oriented company in a commercial operation and bring the technology to the Americas: projects "Card Technologies LATAM" (started 2014) and project "Card Technologies North America" (started 2016).

￼THE FOUNDER

Serigne Dioum is a Doctor in Physical Science and holds a PhD from the Université d'Orléans on Energetics (Plasmas & Laser), Photonics, and on the Mechanic of Fluids, Thermodynamic Systems and Nanotechnology. While a senior researcher with GREMI (a division of the prestigious French CNRS), Serigne participated in the elaboration of NANOCAR+. He was also a senior researcher with CRMD (Research Center on Divided Matter) at CNRS.
Note: CNRS, the National Center for Scientific Research (Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique, www.cnrs.fr) is the largest governmental research organization in France and the largest fundamental science agency in Europe. It employs 26,000 permanent employees (research engineers and support staff).

￼￼THE RESEARCH

In the course of his research activities, Dr. Dioum made the invention that would be the basis of NANOCAR+: an innovative Filtration Method for purification and treatment of water and other fluids. In the following years, he further developed the process (underlying science and manufacturing technology) and the product (the NANOCAR+ Filtration Media). The invention was patented in France in September 2011 (At present the patent is registered in 17 countries, including but not limited to the USA, China, India, Canada, and Venezuela).

- conducting development partnerships to bring to the clinics targeted diagnostic and image-guided therapy nanomaterials based on its proprietary technology.

Name: Laboratoire des Technologies de la Microélectronique - LTMLab
Description:
Le Laboratoire des Technologies de la Microélectronique est une unité mixte de recherche (CNRS / UGA) créée en 1999 et localisée au sein du CEA à Grenoble. Le LTM est structuré en 2 équipes de recherche : MINASEE  (MIcro- & NAno-technologies pour la Santé, l'Environnement et l'Energie) et PROSPECT (PROcédés innovantS pour les dispositifs oPto et nanoEleCTroniques) .
En parallèle de ses activités historiques pilotées par l'évolution des technologies de la nanoélectronique, le LTM utilise les savoir-faire acquis pour développer de nouvelles activités autour de thématiques émergentes, telles que l'IoT (Internet of Things) ou la santé.
Le LTM bénéficie d'un environnement exceptionnel pour développer ses recherches technologiques amont en fort partenariat avec le CEA-LETI.
Avec une forte activité de valorisation et de transfert industriel (création de start-up), le LTM est un trait d’union entre le monde académique et le monde industriel.
Le LTM est également co-gestionnaire de la Plateforme Technologique Amont (PTA), plate-forme à la pointe des micro et nanotechnologies.

Name: ALMAE TECHNOLOGIES
Description:
Almae Technologies was founded in 2016 as an industrial spin-off company from III-V Lab (a joint Nokia, Thales and CEA-Leti industrial research laboratory). Almae Technologies has a business activity focused on advanced R&D, production and sales of innovative photonic technology and next generation photonic products addressing Telecom and Datacom market demand for ultra-high speed optical data transmission.

Almae’s buried heterostructure laser technology offers a seamless solution to scale transmission speed from 10G to more than 100Gb/s. Benefits of our technology are found in lower chip to fiber or waveguide coupling losses, thanks to easy to integrate spot size converter, lower thermal resistance enabling high temperature operation, smallest size modulator and intrinsic low capacitance to give the best overall performance.

Almae is located in the south of Paris at: site Data 4 - Route de Nozay - 91460 Marcoussis - France.

Name: Kwan-tek
Description: KWAN-TEK develops and markets metrology solutions based on diamond quantum sensors, drawing on over 20 years of fundamental research at a global scale. Thanks to our talented and diverse-profile team and to several patents, the company is establishing its position by developing and industrialising a wide range of high-tech, highly-sensitive, stable and robust instruments which represent a new generation of metrology solutions for various demanding applications.

Name: ICOS-International Cooperation On Semiconductors
Description: ICOS, an ambition Horizon Europe project in the framework of the European strategy for semiconductors, will implement cooperation actions in order to participate to the creation of an international network of semiconductor players. It ultimately aims to strengthen Europe’s position in global value chains in this area, dominated by Asia and the United States.

Name: Laboratoire de Photonique et de Nanostructure - C2N
Description:
J'ai créé ce groupe pour sensibiliser les personnes impliquées dans les Nanosciences, au secteur de la Business Intelligence et la Data Science. La Data Intelligence est intrinsèquement dépendante des avancées technologique en Nanoscience.    

https://www.c2n.universite-paris-saclay.fr/fr/

Name: APIX Analytics
Description: APIX Analytics (SA), a startup incorporated in June 2014, is the commercial emanation of 8 years of collaborative research between CEA (France) and California Institute of Technology (Caltech, USA). APIX is focused on the development of highly miniaturized multigas analyzers systems based on integration on silicon of traditional analytical chains: sampling, injection of gases, separation of complex gas mixtures to enhance specificity and then detection, identification and quantification of each mixture compound

Name: SFNano
Description:
The French Society for Nanomedicine  (SFNano) is a non lucrative association whose objectives are to favour progress and knowledge diffusion in the Nanomedicine domain.

Nanomedicine comprises all nanotechnologies devoted to health, including diagnostic, therapy, imaging or theranostic. It includes delivery and targeting, local and systemic administrations, implants and smart nano and microsystems.

SFNano organises seminars, workshops and discussions in order to favour a french network, and much broader, in collaboration with European Nanomedicine Society.

Follow our activity and post any subject matter relevant information on our LinkedIn group!

Name: Institut Galien Paris-Saclay (UMR CNRS 8612)
Description: L'Institut Galien Paris-Saclay (UMR CNRS 8612) développe des micro et nanotechnologies appliquées au médicament et au diagnostic dans le domaine de la santé. La particularité de l’unité est de regrouper des chercheurs et enseignants-chercheurs issus de disciplines différentes: chimie, physico-chimie, galénique, chimie-analytique et biologie.

Name: Nanomakers
Description:
Nanomakers designs, produces and commercializes high purity silicon-based nanoparticles with an innovative synthesis process for :
-	The mechanical and thermal reinforcement of polymeric materials
-	The production of outperforming ceramic parts
-	The increase of Li-ions batteries anode capacity
-	The production of diverse nanocomposite products

Name: Laboratoire TIMA / TIMA Laboratory
Description:
TIMA est un laboratoire public de recherche sous la tutelle du Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique (CNRS), de l’Institut Polytechnique de Grenoble (Grenoble INP), et de l’Université Grenoble Alpes (UGA).

TIMA is a public joint research laboratory of the CNRS, Grenoble-INP and UGA. TIMA is a multinational team, with members and interns from all over the world.

Name: CST - Crime Science Technology
Description:
Crime Science Technology (CST) develops innovative solutions for identifying persons and securing of documents and products. These solutions are based on innovations developed with the CNRS (French National Center for Scientific Research) and the Ecole Normale Supérieure de Cachan. 
 
In the forensic field, our expertise also relies on numerous synergies with public institutions such as the French Forensic Medicine Institute and the INPS (National Institute for Forensic Science). Moreover, it is supported by ongoing exchanges with Technical and Scientific Polices abroad.
 
CST has developed and markets since 2013, the LUMICYANO : the first  one step fluorescent cyanoacrylate used for development of latent fingerprints, a deemed revolutionary process. 
It is already adopted by several scientific polices in the world such as the French Police, the FBI or Scotland Yard.
 
CST is also developing a range of authentication technologies from the development of the synthesis of fluorescent molecules for securing identity titles, trust securities, banknotes and products.

Name: LIFE-01
Description:
Le projet LIFE - Live In a Fabulous Environment à pour ambition de permettre à tous et à chacun de vivre dans un environnement intérieur sain où la qualité de l'air est maîtrisée.
Fort d'une expertise de plus de 40 ans dans le domaine, nous avons créé une startup qui va révolutionner notre experience de vie dans nos logements en nous assurant santé, confort et bien être.
LIFE-01 propose une gamme d'épurateurs d'air intérieur designs, connectés, intelligents et autonomes pour nos logements. 
Simple d'utilisation et accessible à tous, nos produits participent à résoudre l'enjeux social et sanitaire que représente la pollution de l'air et la vie de l'Homme dans les environnements intérieurs.

Name: Laboratoire des Matériaux et du Génie Physique (LMGP)
Description:
The Materials and Physical Engineering Laboratory (LMGP) is a research laboratory in materials science and materials for biomedical engineering.
 It is a joint Research Unit (UMR 5628) of CNRS and Grenoble INP within the Grenoble Alpes University, and is located on the Minatec campus in the buildings of the engineering school PHELMA (PHysics, ELectronics, MAterials).

Intership, PhD and postdoc position are presented in our web page http://www.lmgp.grenoble-inp.fr/welcome-to-lmgp/

Its own equipment and the support of three high-level research platforms (Materials Characterization Center of Grenoble INP, Interuniversity Centre of Microelectronics and Nanotechnologies, Upstream Technology Platform) provide LGMP researchers with the technical resources they need.

The laboratory benefits from a wide network of partners. In materials science and nanosciences, the close links built with other Grenoble laboratories are firmly established via our participation in  the CEMAM and MINOS Centers of excellence and in the FMNT. Its intense activity in the field of tissue engineering has also led LMGP to create close links with various renowned research institutes in biology.

Thanks to the dynamism of its three research teams and the favorable multidisciplinary environment, LMGP has gained an international reputation in the fields of crystal growth, nanomaterials and structured thin film materials and biomaterials for tissue engineering. The interaction between the teams help fostering synergies and new skills. LMGP develops functional materials for applications in the field of microelectronics, energy, and health and thus participates in applied research, in close relationship with companies.

With about fifty researchers, lecturers, engineers, technicians and administrative staff, the laboratory welcomes every year about 60 students and non-permanent researchers at all levels: internships (IUT, Master ...), PhD theses, post-doctoral stays, invited researchers and professors.

Name: Keey Aerogel
Description: Keey Aerogel is an aerogel manufacturer and technology provider.

Name: Veillenanos
Description:
AVICENN, association d'intérêt général, exerce une veille citoyenne et propose sur le site http://veillenanos.fr une information transversale et indépendante sur les enjeux sociétaux soulevés par les nanos. 
Elle agit pour davantage de transparence et de vigilance dans le domaine nano.

Name: MSCA Doctoral Network - STRIKE
Description: STRIKE brings together 12 institutes of academic and non-academic sectors from 8 EU countries with the aim to STRIKE malignant tumors using innovative magnetic nanomaterials. New experimental aspects on design and synthesis of nanostructured magnetic materials are applied to the development of innovative magnetic field-responsive nanotherapeutics for osteosarcoma (OS) combinational therapy. Moreover, the peculiar features of STRIKE nanomaterials are exploited for liquid biopsy using biological samples of BRCA+ breast cancer (BC) patients. The cooperation among outstanding universities, research institutes and industries provides the ESRs with trans-national exchanges and the most innovative research trainings in novel anticancer therapeutic strategies, including in vivo biological evaluation, imaging in OS and early diagnosis in BC. STRIKE will raise excellence in research and training in nanomedicine/precision medicine creating new generation of entrepreneurial and innovative multidisciplinary Early Stage Researchers (ESRs).
Location: Nantes, Pays de la Loire, France

Name: Sumitomo (SHI) Material Solutions Europe
Description:
Laser Systems & Solutions of Europe (LASSE), filiale du groupe japonais SCREEN Semiconductor Solutions basée à Gennevilliers (Hauts de Seine) développe et produit des machines lasers de traitement thermique utilisées pour la fabrication de composants semi-conducteurs avancés.

Les équipements LASSE extrêmement complexes utilisent un laser UV de très forte énergie unique au monde et intègrent les technologies associées : systèmes optiques complexes, métrologie de précision, robotique, électronique et informatique embarquée. Ils permettent la réalisation de traitements thermiques très spécifiques (recristallisation, activation...) sur des couches minces constitutives des composants semi-conducteurs les plus avancés.

Les machines LASSE sont intégrées aux chaînes de fabrication d'acteurs majeurs de la micro et nano-électronique en Asie, Europe et USA.

Name: NanoMesureFrance Association
Description:
NanoMesureFrance contributes to structuring the industrial nanomaterials sector by bringing together all relevant stakeholders around reliable and recognized data.

Our ambition is to build a shared foundation of trust, serving both the competitiveness and safety of innovation.

Our missions are structured around six key areas:
 Identify:
o	The dimensions of objects that may constitute (nano)materials
o	The needs of industrial players in terms of both measurement methods and materials to be considered
 Characterize:
o	The “identity profile” of nanomaterials
o	The specific requirements of industries according to their sectors, material types, and intended uses
 Assess:
o	The emission of nano-objects at various stages of product life cycles
o	The capabilities of service providers and analytical platforms
 Share:
o	Ongoing projects and initiatives in France, Europe, and worldwide
o	Reference methods and guidance documents through a dedicated knowledge base
o	A mapping of available analytical resources and expertise
 Connect:
o	Our members with all stakeholders across the ecosystem
o	Through working groups, webinars, workshops, and other networking events
 Coordinate:
o	The development, validation, and harmonization of testing methods
o	The promotion of the association’s work within national, European, and international networks of influence

Chemistry & Materials – Cosmetics – Nanomedicine – Instrumentation & Sensors are the four main thematic areas structuring our members’ activities.

They collaborate within dedicated working groups as well as during workshops.

The topics addressed, along with the documents produced, directly support R&D objectives and regulatory expectations across the relevant sectors.

Interested in joining us?

Find out how to become a member here: https://www.nanomesurefrance.fr/pourquoi-et-comment-adherer/

Name: ANNEALSYS
Description:
Annealsys designs and manufactures Rapid Thermal Processing (RTP) and Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) systems. Our customers are companies for production applications and R&D laboratories in the fields of silicon, compound semiconductors, nanotechnologies, MEMS, etc.
With 300 systems installed worldwide, Annealsys is a leading manufacturer of RTP systems for special production applications using substrates up to 200 mm.
Our cold wall chamber RTP furnaces can perform processes up to 1450°C. Pulse annealing process is available to anneal thermally sensitive substrates. It is possible to carry out process under any types of gases, from atmospheric pressure down to high vacuum.
Applications: implantation annealing, contact annealing, rapid thermal oxidation, nitridation, selenization, sulfurization, CVD of graphene and h-BN, etc.
A high temperature RTP furnace for processes up to 2000°C is available for silicon carbide implantation annealing and graphene generation by sublimation of silicon from SiC.
Our Direct Liquid Injection (DLI) CVD and ALD deposition systems offer the highest process versatility for development of new materials by utilization of low vapor and thermally unstable precursors. They can handle most of the materials of the periodic table and offer unique process and material development capabilities. The 50 mm machine (MC-050) uses a lamp heating and allows in-situ annealing. All DLI-CVD reactors can perform DLI-ALD and pulse pressure CVD processes inside the same chamber.
Applications: Semiconductor, micro batteries, BAW and SAW filters, 2D materials, energy harvesting, etc.
Our philosophy involves building up a long-term relationship with our customers, provide high reliability and high quality tools, insure low cost of ownership and offer outstanding customer support and service. To achieve this, we have created a worldwide network with trained engineers for sales and service.

Name: BioAxial, part of Telight
Description:
BioAxial is now part of Telight. Please follow our news at Telight LinkedIn page https://linkedin.com/company/telight

TELIGHT specializes in a field of instruments employing light optics, in particular, providing innovative types and solutions for light microscopy.

Name: SENSE in
Description:
SENSE in is a monitoring specialist of composite parts during both manufacturing (PHM - Process Health Monitoring) and usage (SHM - Structural Health Monitoring). Our sensors are non-intrusive and integrated at the core of the composite during its fabrication, enabling the tracking of various parameters throughout the material's lifespan, including resin flow, temperature, and damage.

SENSE in has also developed a unique solution for ceramics monitoring. This monitoring technology allows for the detection of microcracks related to the manufacturing process, usage, or transportation. The sensor is undetectable, of negligible weight, and non-intrusive.

Name: Schaefer Scientific
Description:
Schaefer Scientific (formerly Schaefer Technologie) is a trusted partner in scientific and engineering innovation since 1963. With a presence in five European countries, we specialize in marketing and supporting cutting-edge technologies across a wide range of scientific fields.

As one of Europe’s leading trading and consulting companies, we represent top-tier manufacturers in Germany and across the continent. Our portfolio includes advanced solutions in electron and scanning probe microscopy, vacuum measurement and control, thermal mass flow systems, tissue cytometry and 3D live-cell imaging, as well as particle, nanoparticle, and spectrometry technologies.

Our expert team of scientists and engineers offers personalized consultation and ongoing support — from initial discussions through to system implementation. We also conduct feasibility studies and trial work in our in-house laboratories to ensure each solution fits the unique challenges of our clients.

Name: MINT Lab - Université d'Angers
Description: The MINT lab' (UMR INSERM U1066 and CNRS 6021) consists of 40 researchers and students. Our research: the design of nano and micro-scaled vectors for the delivery of drugs.
Location: Angers, Pays de la Loire, France

Name: ESONN
Description:
European School On Nanosciences & Nanotechnologies, Grenoble, France.
ESONN is a two-week course aimed at providing training for graduate students, postdoctoral and junior scientists in the field of nanosciences and nanotechnologies. The academic and practical courses cover topics such as the elaboration, characterization and functionalities of nano-objects.

Name: Cordouan Technologies SAS
Description:
Cordouan Technologies SAS is specialized in the design, fabrication & industrialization of innovative instruments for physico-chemical characterization (size, charge, shape) of nanoparticles and nanomaterials for academic research & industrial application (process monitoring, quality control, R&D). 

We offer to our customers measurement solutions for granulometry, zetametry, electronic microscopy and preparation accessories. We use among other techniques : the Dynamic Light Scattering (DLS) method for size measurement, the Laser Doppler Electrophoresis (LDE) technique for Zeta potential analysis and the Laser Induced Breakdown Detection (LIBD) technique for nanoparticle traces detection in water. Our unique product portfolio is issued from patented and innovative technologies transferred from prestigious research institutes: Institut Français du Pétrole (IFPEN), Karlsruhe Institute of Technologie (KIT), Institut Charles Sadron (ICS).

Name: Voltify
Description: Conception, fabrication et vente de dispositifs de stockage de l'énergie ultra denses et compacts (micro-condensateurs, micro-batteries Li-ion tout solide).

Name: CROMA  ("UMR 5130": CNRS, Grenoble-INP, UGA, USMB)
Description:
Les activités de recherche de CROMA couvrent un spectre très large allant de la microéléctronique CMOS à la photonique en passant par les ondes millimétriques et térahertz.
Elles concernent aussi bien des recherches en micro et nano-technologies, qu’en conception de circuits, microsystèmes et systèmes ou qu’en caractérisation de ceux-ci.

Name: OLEO INTERNATIONAL
Description:
Oleo International manufactures a filtration system that meets all the water needs of a home: drinking, cooking, personal hygiene and of course for household chores and the supply of household appliances. The water we find in our taps continues to deteriorate for reasons known to all: industrial and agricultural discharges, excessive consumption of medicines, the degrading state of water pipes and water pollution in general. 

OUR MISSION :
Protect your water, your air, your health

Name: CSInstruments - Atomic Force Microscopy
Description: CSInstruments is a French scientific equipment manufacturer specialized in the conception of Atomic Force Microscopes. Its activities are focused on research, development and design of simple solution, innovative and quality around the AFM to allow researchers and industry to improve their research project. The product range proposed by CSInstruments is designed and manufactured to help the scientific community to achieve nanometer performances that meet the research needs and requirements for actual and future nanoscience applications.

Name: SILIOS Technologies
Description:
SILIOS designs and manufactures micro-optics for laser beam shaping and visible/NIR spectrometry applications. 

The company has been established in 2001. SILIOS is a spin-off from another bigger SME involved in the field of microelectronics (Ion Beam Services, 65 people, annual turnover: 7 M€). 

SILIOS Technologies takes benefit from the microelectronic technologies, tools and methods to manufacture micro-optical components. Those components address various fields of applications: beam shaping for medical laser, tooling laser or scientific lasers, micro-spectrometer applications, aberration generation... The company is engaged in many research fields covering micro-optics manufacture and optical instruments development. 

Each year SILIOS invests more than 20% of its annual turnover in R&D to develop leading edge solutions. In particular, SILIOS started the development of its COLOR SHADES technology for the manufacturing of multi-spectral filters few years ago. The technology found applications in the field of spectrometry and microscopy. The company aims now to enter the field of imaging and multi-spectral imaging.

Name: GdR Or-Nano
Description: Or-nano est un réseau de chercheurs centré sur les nanoparticules d’or, soutenu par le CNRS comme Groupement de Recherche, depuis janvier 2017 (GdR n° 2002). Il regroupe environ 800 chercheurs de 74 équipes différentes en France.

Name: MICROWORLD
Description:
Microworld is a Distributor & Integrator of Technical High-Tec Equipment and accessories
The world's best manufacturers offering the best equipment choice and a range of accessories fitting all production and laboratories needs.
Tests recipes & Parameters, matching equipment, accessories...Our Expert Service Team provide the perfect solution with technical advices and adequate product configuration.
We keep listening to your expectations and will propose our solutions upon review of your application, the service includes the installation, test and acceptance sequence, users and maintenance training and warranty.

Product family:

-Probe stations
-Equipment for thin layer characterization
-4 points probes
-Test and burn-in socket 
-Thermal forcing systems, oven
-Equipment and consumable for Dicing
-Front end back end solutions
-...

Name: Mathym
Description:
Mathym, founded in 2013 and integrated into the Baikowski group in 2019, is a nanotechnology company that specializes in the development and manufacturing of innovative and unique nano-dispersions. 
The different inorganic parts we have been developing offer critical properties, like radiopacity, refractive index enhancement or wear resistance, while their nanosized structures preserve a very high level of transparency and increase their activity when high specific surface areas are at stake. Our products are currently used in the dental, energy, fine ceramics and 3D-printing sectors. Our expertise in liquid-dispersed inorganic nanomaterials aims at complementing the range of Baikowski fine oxide minerals for high-end products .
As part of the group, Mathym benefits, from Baikowski's commercial network around the world and more particularly in Japan and the USA.

Name: ENWIRES
Description:
ENWIRES is a unique company producing silicon nanowire-based anode materials at an industrial scale and a competitive price
#deeptech #startup #innovation #LowCarbonTransition  #climatechange #energy  #batteries #AnodeMaterial

Name: Hekat fluidics
Description:
Hekat fluidics is pioneering the first nanoscale fluorescence-activated flow sorter. 
Leveraging our innovative microfluidic technology, enables high-throughput detection, counting, and individual sorting of nano-objects according to biological or functional markers.

Name: DIVINCELL
Description: DIVINCELL is a BioPharmaceutical NanoMedicine company pioneering a novel drug delivery technology for the treatment of cancer and genetic diseases. DIVINCELL is specialized in the preclinical and pharmaceutical development of therapeutics using a patented peptide-based delivery platform. DIVINCELL offers innovative solutions to tackle nucleic acid/protein/peptide-based drug cellular uptake limitations, based on 20 years of research in the field of transfection. DIVINCELL is developing and plans to commercialize its innovative drug delivery platform through strategic relationships with established laboratories and pharmaceutical companies. The therapeutics developed by DIVINCELL have been validated using cancer and other therapeutic models (hemophilia, metabolic disorders) and provided an efficient alternative to existing drug delivery methods for a wide range of diseases. This breakthrough technology will have therapeutic potential enabling optimization of treatment accuracy and increasing patient safety.

Name: Plasmalex
Description:
As a fully integrated research, development and engineering group, 
Plasmalex provides complete solutions for nanoscale surface treatment, functional modification and conversion of web processed materials and objects, with the lowest possible environmental impact. The Plasmalex group combines the Europlasma and CPI division and partners with sister company Spoolex.

Name: FMNT
Description:
La Fédération Micro Nano Technologies regroupe sept laboratoires grenoblois, acteurs majeurs dans le domaine de la microélectronique, des nanotechnologies et des architectures matérielles.
Nos 7 laboratoires : CROMA, LMGP, LTM, Spintec, G2Elab, TIMA, LCIS
Nos tutelles : CNRS, Université Grenoble Alpes, Grenoble INP-UGA

Name: 3D-Oxides
Description:
3D-Oxides is a company involved in oxides thin film deposition to develop new materials towards vertical integration of new functions. 
The speciality of the company is to develop thin films materials with uo to 6 elements and complex 1-2 or 3Dimension shapes.

Name: SYNERGIE4
Description:
SYNERGIE4 est votre interlocuteur privilégié pour ce qui concerne la microanalyse, la micro tomographie par rayons X, le dépôt de couches minces et également la microscopie électronique.

Toujours à la recherche de la satisfaction de nos clients, nous vous proposons des solutions complètes pour : 
-	des microscopes électroniques (MEB de table, MEB, MEB FIB et MET)
-	des systèmes EDS, WDS, μXRF et EBSD
-	des appareils de micro tomographie
-	des Pico et Nano-Indenteurs pour MEB et MET
-	des micromanipulateurs, micro-injecteurs et stations de tests électriques pour MEB et MET
-	des appareils de découpe et de polissage par faisceau d’ions
-	des appareils de dépôts de couches minces

Name: Plateforme E-Santé Expertise
Description: La plateforme E-santé Expertise s’adresse à tous les acteurs de l’écosystème de la santé numérique.

Name: R&Dnano
Description:
R&Dnano defines itself as an innovation catalyst. This young company, founded in 2007 to promote a CNRS patent (winner of the national competition for the creation of an innovative company in 2007), leads an R&D activity in the form of services with its customers. We use the stable sol-gel compounds we have developed to create innovative coatings and surface treatments for industrial applications.

Its founders are passionate about industrial innovation. They listen industrial managers and offer to push simple idea or exposed problematic to the stage of the prototype, or even pre-industrialization. Our different types of formulations allow our team to propose ingenious adaptations in wide diversity of industrial fields.

Located in Strasbourg, in the middle of the Rhine basin, R&Dnano has a team of 5 experienced engineers, researchers and scientific advisers. Helped by a strong national network, our company is currently pursuing its international expansion.

R&Dnano is a partner of the R&Dnano, a group of companies recognised for its expertise in the transfer of technology in the field of surface treatments. This structure is a partner of the IRT M2P (Institute of Technological Research – Materials, Metallurgy and Processes).

We contribute to different national projects financed by the ANR or the European Community. For example, R&Dnano formulates, in the AfterALM project, self-leveling coatings for metal parts resulting from additive manufacturing.

Name: EU H2020 NEURONN
Description:
EU H2020 ICT NEURONN 2020-2022 
Two-Dimensional Oscillatory Neural Networks for Energy Efficient Neuromorphic Computing

Coordinator: Dr. Aida Todri-Sanial, CNRS
Partners: 
CNRS, FR
IBM Research Zurich, Switzerland
Fraunhofer, Germany
CSIC/University of Seville, Spain
Silvaco, UK
A.I. Mergence, France

Advisory Board:
Intel, Germany
Prophesee, France

Neuro-inspired computing employs technologies that enable brain-inspired computing hardware for more efficient and adaptive intelligent systems. Mimicking the human brain and nervous system, these computing architectures are excellent candidates for solving complex and large-scale associative learning problems. 

The EU-funded NeurONN project will showcase a novel and alternative neuromorphic computing paradigm based on energy-efficient devices and architectures. In the proposed neuro-inspired computing architecture, information will be encoded in the phase of coupled oscillating neurons or oscillatory neural networks (ONN).

Name: LabInGlass-Klearia's foundry
Description: LabInGlass is a french manufacturer which propose custom microfluidics/ electrodes coating and integrated Lab-on-Chip solutions in glass materials. We also support project upscaling from chip to end-user solutions.

Name: VUICHARD SAS
Description:
Entreprise spécialisée depuis plus de 50 ans dans les micro usinages. Elle est basée  aux portes de Genève et compte une filial, Nano Cut sarl , basée à Genève pour le marché Suisse.
Les activitées de l'entreprise sont les suivantes :
- micro decoupe laser
- micro électro-érosion d'enfonçage
- micro découpe en électro-érosion à fil
- micro fraisage 5 axes
- micro perçage en électro-érosion
- micro tournage en électro-érosion

Name: METRINO Project
Description:
The METRINO project is an ambitious European collaborative initiative funded by the European Partnership on Metrology (EURAMET Partnership #22HLT04), aiming to establish Europe as a leader in nanomedicine metrology.

METRINO focus on developing and validating traceable measurement methods and reference materials for the quality assessment of innovative medicinal products and medical devices containing nanomaterials, including synthetic lipid-based particles such as liposomes and LNPs-RNA, and metal oxide nanoparticles tailored for clinical formulations.

MetrINo aims to support industrial stakeholders in implementing regulatory directives (e.g. EMA, MDR, and FDA), as well as contribute to the development of suitable reference materials and consensus standards.

We believe METRINO has the potential to transform the European nanomedicine landscape, ultimately leading to improved patient outcomes and a more competitive European health technology industry.

The consortium, coordinated by LNE in France, brings together 9 leading European NMIs in the field, complemented by 3 universities, 3 large RTOs, 2 pharmaceutical company and 1 SME producing innovative nanotherapeutics, 1 hospital and the ETPN association (in charge of Communication & Impact) are included in the consortium, providing the complementary expertise.

Come join us as we create the next standards for integrating #nanotechnology into #healthcare solutions!

Name: Grand Potentiel
Description:
Le Grand Potentiel est l'association des étudiants du département Génie Physique, de l'INSA Toulouse. Celle-ci a été fondée pour enrichir les relations entre étudiants, enseignants, chercheurs et entreprises. L'association organise des conférences et des visites d'entreprises afin de permettre aux étudiants de développer leur réseau professionnel et d'avoir une vision plus précise de leur future carrière.

Elle sert aussi de lien entre les étudiants et la direction du département, afin d'améliorer le cadre d'études des étudiants.

Enfin, l'organisation de repas, d'événements et de soirées sur le thème de la physique permet de promouvoir le département et de rassembler les différentes promotions, anciennes ou nouvelles, autour de la physique. 

Contact : grandpotentiel.insa@gmail.com

Name: CLIMB Doctoral Network
Description:
The CLIMB Doctoral Network is a consortium of leading European research institutions aimed at training the next generation of researchers in the physics and chemistry of complex lipid-based systems.  

The objectives of the CLIMB core research project are to investigate how lipid composition governs membrane structure, molecular interactions, and collective behaviours. Through a multidisciplinary approach, the network will design and characterise complex lipid assemblies for advanced applications in mRNA delivery, biosensing, and sustainable formulations.

Name: SILSEF
Description:
SILSEF is a French start-up, founded in 2010, based at Archamps Technopole on the French-Swiss border near Geneva. We share a 20 000 sq ft plant with industrial wafer manufacturer Sil'tronix Silicon Technologies.
The facilities include clean rooms to provide the quality required for micro/opto-electronics and bio-medical applications.  The team includes 10 highly skilled staff, mostly qualified engineers and PhDs.

Our key technology is Nano Imprint Lithography (NIL) invented in 1995 in the U.S, to reduce the size of microelectronic circuits. It is ranked among the revolutionary technologies by the MIT ("Ten Technologies That can change the world"), thanks to its generic and large variety of applications.
The invention is to replicate nanoscale designs over a wide range of materials in volume and at minor costs. Our challenge is to implement the two following options to offer tailor-made solutions : 
           -NIL with an etching step
           -Nano Embossing Polymer (NEP)

The technology allows also double scale patterns such as macro-channels (100 μm wide) with nano-structured areas (100 nm in size).
Our skills cover the whole technology chain to meet your expectations : 
           -Design of patterns including simulation and modelling
           -Manufacture of stamps at micro and nanoscale 
           -Transfer patterns on a range of materials
           -Geometric and functional characterizations

It is supported by the NILAB (Nano Imprint Laboratory), a technology platform that brings together first class academic and industrial partners. Thus, in addition to its internal resources, SILSEF can call upon wide scientific and technological resources to assess your requirements and best respond to your specifications.

La vocation d’EDEN Instruments est de proposer aux académiques, aux industriels, aux plateformes scientifiques une solution technique globale d’imagerie et d’analyse avec une grande compatibilité entre tous les équipements In-Situ/ in-Operando et Ex-Situ utilisés pour la microscopie électronique.

Les domaines d’applications sont innombrables principalement avec l’avènement des nouvelles technologies Nano, tant dans le secteur des Matériaux que dans celui de la Science du Vivant :

Expertise de l’environnement
Expertise sur matériel Spatial
Technologie des semi-conducteurs et micro fabrication 
Géosciences et Matériaux 
Matériaux du génie Civil 
Matériaux du Patrimoine Culturel
Nanomatériaux 
Recherche de traces en police scientifique
Marché de l’analyse de l’amiante suivant normalisation COFRAC norme NFX 43050
Sciences du vivant

Toutes les études scientifiques et industrielles nécessitent la compréhension de taille, de morphologie, d’orientation cristallographique, associées à la composition chimique qualitative et quantitative d’un échantillon.

Les solutions de nano caractérisation proposées par EDEN Instruments comprennent des équipements pour l’étude des échantillons en micro-analyse MEB EDS, EBSD, WDS, en micro-XRF (ORBIS), pour la microscopie électronique MET/MEB In-Operando, pour la microscopie corrélative (SCLEM), pour la cathodo luminescence, pour des essais électriques/ mécaniques (traction, flexion, compression,) pour du positionnement/ manipulation à l’échelle micro et nano ainsi que pour la préparation des échantillons.

Transforming Cancer Detection Through miRNA Technology
In the battle against cancer, early detection is the key to saving lives. Yet, for far too long, the limitations of existing detection methods have left us with critical challenges. Traditional approaches are often invasive, costly, and can miss the mark when it comes to detecting cancer at its earliest and most treatable stages.
Why miRNAs Matter:
This is where miRNAs step into the spotlight. MicroRNAs, abbreviated as miRNAs, are tiny but powerful molecules found within our cells. They hold immense promise as game-changing biomarkers for cancer detection. MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are tiny molecules with enormous potential. As biomarkers, they offer a new frontier in cancer detection and follow-up, providing precise insights into early-stage disease.
Our Mission:
At e-miRgency, we're pioneers in harnessing miRNA technology to revolutionize cancer diagnostics. Our solutions empower early intervention, and a brighter future.
Join the Fight:
Explore our website to see how we're reshaping cancer detection. Together, we can rewrite the narrative, offering hope and progress in the fight against cancer.

Name: Twisted Nano
Description:
Drug discovery demands reliable, ultrasensitive and fast techniques to test small drug volumes. The efficacy and biotoxicity of drugs is heavily affected by their chiral configuration. In turn, pharmaceutical companies routinely encounter a looking-glass world of mirror-image molecules – enantiomers - where chiral sensing of small drug volumes plays a pivotal role for drug discovery and nanomedicine. 

TwistedNano addresses this need with a new generation of integrated nanophotonic devices enabling the characterization of small quantities of chiral drugs with volumes of a few nanolitres through light, revolutionizing at source the technological toolbox for drug discovery and nanomedicine.

Name: BlackHole Lab
Description:
BlackHole Lab presentation:

BlackHole Lab has been created to provide turnkey soft lithography stations to research laboratories. In 2008, during their Phd in microfluidics, BlackHole Lab founders saw the need for numbers of laboratories to have their own microfabrication facilities in order to make their own chips quickly and easily. They developed in 2009 their first generation of softlithography station for researches institutes in Paris and Philadelphia. After several years of improvement, Black Hole lab now provide a full range of turnkey soft lithography station all over the world.

Usually microfluidic chips are made in a clean room but the purchase and maintenance of one is really expensive. So the tricky idea was to propose a set of equipment usable out of a clean room and with the same efficiency. BlackHole Lab offer well-thinking set which is working together to give the best answer for microfluidic fabrication. But it’s not limited to it and BlackHole Lab is still improving or adapting the offers to keep at the cutting edge of the technology. It has been done the choice to gather numerous PhD inside the company to be as close as possible of the researchers, like that the need is really understood and a real exchange on a wide range of subjects is possible. Finally, the BlackHole Lab dynamism enables to be really responsive and flexible to any researcher’s requests.

In one sentence, the aim of BlackHole Lab is to open the microfabrication and so the microfluidic to anyone.
